content.short: Cope is a GameFi decentralized application on Solana.
content.description: Cope is a play-to-earn decentralized app on the Solana blockchain, home to a vibrant community of gamers. Members rise on the leaderboard by providing accurate trading calls for the community, turning collective signals into real outcomes. Cope supports staking across Solana with two options: stake COPE in Solana-native liquidity pools such as Raydium, or stake in Solana-native wallets like Phantom or Sollet, enabling flexible participation across the network.
